schema: root(director) > chief_engineer > zone > region > division > ccc. Each node: level, name, aliases?, code?, confidence (confirmed|partial|inferred), source (indexes into sources[]), note?. region.unplacedCccs[] = CCCs known to belong to the region whose current division is not public.

confidenceKey.confirmed: stated by a current (2023-2025) WBSEDCL source, or by the app office master and a public WBSEDCL source together
confidenceKey.partial: stated by one source only, or by an older (2016) WBSEDCL list whose division may since have been split
confidenceKey.inferred: derived (name match, geography), not stated by any source

titles.director: Director (Distribution), board member under the CMD; Executive Director (Distribution) below [5,8]
titles.region: Regional Manager (RM), typically Superintending Engineer or Divisional Engineer rank [2,8,13,14]
titles.ccc: Station Manager (S.M.), usually an Assistant Engineer, written "A.E & S.M" [9,10,14]

root.name: Director (Distribution)
root.note: Board-level functional director under the Chairman & Managing Director. An Executive Director (Distribution) also appears in the Aug-2025 memo. Below sit two field Chief Engineers, CE Distribution (North) and CE Distribution (South), and the six Zonal Managers. Which zones report to which CE is not published; the split below is inferred from geography.
